title: chromolaena plumeri
intro: Chromolaena plumeri, commonly known as Eupatorium, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing fever, relieving pain and inflammation, and treating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Chromolaena plumeri include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins. These constituents contribute to the plant's ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress.
